sources.snippet: This repo is a comprehensive toolbox and library for X-ray 3D reconstruction including two tasks, novel view synthesis (NVS) and computed tomography (CT) reconstruction. This repo supports 12 state-of-the-art methods including six NeRF-based methods, three 3DGS-based methods, two optimization-based methods, and one analytical method. sources.snippet: The SAX-NeRF & X-Gaussian toolbox serves as a unified platform for X-ray 3D reconstruction research. It integrates 11 state-of-the-art methods spanning neural rendering, Gaussian splatting, optimization-based approaches, and analytical methods.
